description: This file defines a class 'ImageDragListener' implementing the 'View.OnDragListener' interface for handling drag-and-drop events on a View, specifically for drag-and-drop of images via URIs.

classes.name: ImageDragListener
classes.description: Implements drag-and-drop handling for images, changing background colors based on drag state, and setting the image URI when dropped.

methods.name: onDrag
methods.description: Handles drag events and updates UI or processes the drop accordingly.

methods.name: setTargetColor
methods.description: Sets the background color of the view based on drag state.

methods.name: processDrop
methods.description: Processes a drop event, extracts URI from ClipData, and updates the ImageView.

methods.name: processLocation
methods.description: Placeholder method for processing drag location; no implementation provided.

methods.name: setImageUri
methods.description: Sets the image URI to the view if it is an instance of ImageView.
